modes.text: Treat this request as a layout-only revision and preserve all existing Operations Analyst content.

Preserve the current professional title, Summary, Experience text, Skills wording, Projects, Certifications, Languages, Education text, candidate name, contact information, colors, typography, header, sidebar, and two-column architecture.
Correct the visible collision between the “Process Design” and “Excel” bullet rows in the Skills section.
Keep both “Process Design” and “Excel” as separate Skills entries; do not delete, combine, rename, or rewrite either entry.
Position “Excel” below “Process Design” with clear positive vertical separation.
Use the same visual line spacing between “Process Design” and “Excel” that is used between the other Skills bullet rows.
Verify the entire Skills list from Operational Analysis through SQL Basics and ensure every consecutive bullet has consistent readable vertical spacing.
Ensure no Skills bullet touches, overlaps, clips, or visually merges with another Skills bullet.
If correcting the Skills bullet positions changes the total Skills section height, safely reflow Projects, Certifications, and Languages downward or upward as required while preserving their order.
Maintain a consistent section gap between the end of Skills and the Projects heading.
Maintain a consistent section gap between the end of Projects and the Certifications heading.
Maintain a consistent section gap between the end of Certifications and the Languages heading.
Reduce the vertical gap between the final Experience content and the Education heading.
Move the Education section upward so it follows the final Fieldwork Media Experience entry with a normal readable major-section gap.
Use the Summary-to-Experience spacing and the existing right-column visual rhythm as references when positioning Education after Experience.
Preserve the current Education heading, degree, institution, certificate, and dates; change only its vertical positioning.
Do not rewrite Experience or Education content in order to perform these positioning changes.
Do not introduce a new large blank gap elsewhere when Education is moved upward.
Keep Education below Experience and ensure there is clear positive separation with no overlap.
After the layout adjustment, verify that the Skills section has zero text overlaps.
After the layout adjustment, verify that the entire resume has zero text overlaps and zero page out-of-bounds objects.
Before returning to Founder Review, visually verify that “Process Design” and “Excel” are clearly separated and that Education follows Experience without an excessive blank vertical gap.
Return the same one-page Operations Analyst Resume Template with the existing content preserved and only the remaining Skills spacing and Experience-to-Education positioning corrected.
